task: Alpha Memory Implementation Step 3 -- Historical Observation + Recurrence Memory (SHADOW ONLY, descriptive only)
head: 9f228723fad5406c72e62beca67ec70ea0fdb004

recurrence_definition.rule: is_recurring = prior_observation_count >= 1 -- the exact same atomic phi_id (identity model frozen at Step 2, unchanged) exists in at least one prior, history-eligible run.
recurrence_definition.no_fuzzy_or_equivalence: No embeddings, no semantic matching, no edge-type equivalence, no Alpha equivalence -- exact phi_id equality only.
recurrence_definition.no_scoring_concepts_introduced: No recurrence strength, confidence, weight, streak bonus, decay, or temporal scoring exists anywhere in this step's output.

criteria: exclude the current run (unchanged from Step 1/2)
structure_graph.json + vocabulary_snapshot must be present and derivable (unchanged -- a run with none contributes zero phi, naturally)

taxonomy/identity-version compatibility is enforced structurally by the phi_id hash itself (a mismatch produces a different phi_id and can never silently match) -- no separate filter step needed or added

NEW: a candidate run whose OWN persisted artifact_manifest.json explicitly reports artifact_completeness != 'pass' is excluded -- reusing the ONE existing, already-authoritative per-run completeness signal this codebase has (Sprint 1 Track A2), never inventing a new 'healthy run' standard
historical_run_eligibility_rule.runs_with_no_manifest_at_all: NOT excluded on that basis alone -- an old run predating that sprint is an honest gap, not treated as corrupted without evidence.
historical_run_eligibility_rule.reported_limitation: This filter does NOT catch every possible bad run. Concrete example found in this repository's own history: NVDA run 40bd7e3d-2759-45bc-97ec-8f1cf96c2266 was executed while Week2 LLM was disabled, producing zero committed Alpha matches and zero Activation (see scripts/start_live_comqutor.sh's own docstring) -- yet its artifact_manifest.json reports artifact_completeness == 'pass' (its files are all present; they are just semantically empty). No existing authoritative field distinguishes 'complete but semantically empty' from 'complete and meaningful'. This specific failure mode is instead caught incidentally by the pre-existing requirement that a run have real, alpha_ids-linked edges to derive any phi at all -- confirmed empirically: 40bd7e3d has 7 edges, zero of which carry any alpha_ids, so it contributes exactly zero phi structures and can never produce a false historical match. Reported as a real, known gap -- not silently patched over.

observation_count_deduplication_rule.rule: One phi counts at most once per run -- deduplicated by (run_id, phi_id) in find_prior_phi_edge_observations before any count is computed. prior_observation_count means the number of DISTINCT prior runs containing the phi, never a count of duplicate edge rows.
observation_count_deduplication_rule.belt_and_suspenders: compute_phi_edges (Step 2) already de-duplicates within a single run at the identity-computation layer; find_prior_phi_edge_observations (this step) adds an explicit, independent second dedup guarantee at the cross-run-matching layer, so correctness does not rely on the first layer's internal behavior alone.

alpha_level_recurrence_summary_fields: historically_matched_phi_count (Step 2 name, retained as an exact alias of recurring_phi_count)
unmatched_phi_count (Step 2 name, retained as an exact alias of first_seen_phi_count)
recurrence_ratio (= recurring_phi_count / current_phi_count when current_phi_count > 0, else null)
recurrence_ratio_is_descriptive_only: Verified by test_alpha_level_recurrence_summary_is_descriptive_only -- no 'score', 'weight', or 'confidence' key exists anywhere in the summary, and summarize_alpha_memory is never imported by activation_scorer_v2.py/alpha_level_classifier.py/conflict_detector.py/conflict_admissibility.py (same architectural guard test as Step 2, re-verified).

real_offline_verification.method: Same persisted NVDA and MSFT runs used throughout the audits and Step 2, current run scanned against its FULL eligible ticker history (not just the one designated pair) -- the actual production reader behavior. No new research, zero Provider/TradingAgents calls.

NVDA.confirms_step2_finding: Step 2's two exact atomic matches (A101, A102 against c9abf687) are both present above, now shown as genuine recurring structures with real source run_ids, alongside additional matches found against the fuller eligible historical corpus (a8d47429, e3eb3909, 948be419, 5ffe121a).

MSFT.honest_result: ZERO recurrence, even when scanning this run's full eligible MSFT history, not just the one designated pair. Not manufactured -- reported exactly as computed. Root cause carried forward from Step 1.6/Step 2: the designated prior pair run (07ddc074) has almost no alpha-linked edges at all, and no other eligible MSFT run in this repository's persisted history happens to share an exact edge with 6cd2566d's own structure.

atomic_recurrence_with_differing_aggrega.real_example: NVDA current run 2f8ee897 vs prior run a8d47429: A101's aggregate_fingerprint_id does NOT match a8d47429's (whole 5-edge set differs), yet A101's individual edge (ai_capex, causal, gpu_demand) DOES recur atomically against a8d47429 (and 4 other prior runs). Same finding for A102 (aggregate differs, one atomic edge recurs) and A103 (aggregate differs, two atomic edges recur). Only A301 (which has just 1 current edge, so its whole set and its one edge carry the same information) shows both aggregate AND atomic agreement with a8d47429.
atomic_recurrence_with_differing_aggrega.interpretation: Exactly the useful, non-invalidation-labeled memory result Section J anticipated: some causal structures recur while the overall Alpha structure changed. Not called drift, failure, or invalidation -- purely descriptive.

instability_signals_cannot_create_or_rem.guarantee: detect_alpha_attribution_variance/detect_edge_type_variance remain pure, read-only, side-effect-free diagnostic functions -- neither is called by, nor can influence, compute_phi_edges/find_prior_phi_edge_observations/summarize_phi_edge_history. A genuinely-detected variance case leaves recurrence exactly as exact phi_id equality alone would determine it.

api_and_ui.api: No new route created. alpha_memory (including every new Step 3 field) continues to be exposed exclusively via the existing internal run_audit.json artifact path established in Step 1/2 -- the same build_run_audit_payload()/write_run_audit_artifact() functions, now producing the extended section automatically. run_audit.json itself has no public GET route by original design (documented in this codebase's own artifact-manifest comment: 'internal audit / evaluation harness (no public GET route)') -- adding one is out of scope for this step and was not done.
api_and_ui.ui: DEFERRED. No frontend code anywhere reads run_audit.json today (confirmed in the original Step 0 audit and re-confirmed now) -- there is no existing alpha_memory-adjacent UI surface to extend with a minimal additive change. Building even a small indicator would require inventing new frontend product surface, which this step's own instruction reserves for a dedicated later UI step. Choice made: DEFER, not build.
